quality_note: 120 real findings, stratified over projects and outcomes, labelled blind by Claude Opus on masked text. Opus is a second model, not human truth. A new prompt had to gain 5 points on the text outcome with no dimension down more than 3 (rule fixed before p4 and p5 ran). Confirmation on 60 fresh findings (p2 → p5): intent 78.3 → 75.0%, actionability 75.0 → 76.7%, validity 65.0 → 70.0%, response 30.0 → 45.0%, outcome 45.0 → 50.0%.

limits: Tone is unreliable (kappa 0.26): Qwen misses most dismissive exchanges. Use fix rate, reply depth and thanks first.
Kappa stays below 0.6 for response, validity and outcome: read these at project and trend level, not per person.
Changed lines are evidence of a change, not proof of a correct fix; about 10 to 20% of direct hits can be chance (placebo check).
Business hours: Mon to Fri 08:00 to 18:00 Europe/Berlin, no public holidays (owner decision D-022).
The name switch in the dashboard is a display switch, not anonymisation.
